text:
maya: Heads up — noticed aggregation accuracy drifting on hourly rollups for user_event_count since 03:00 UTC, looks correlated with missing spans from the ETL worker pool :thinking_face:

sam: 👀 can you paste the query and sample mismatch?

maya: quick sample: prod.daily_user_rollup (2024-07-03T03:00) expected=124, actual=102. Raw spans show no span for user_events ingestion for shard-7.

liam: shard-7 has been flapping, saw increased task retries. Might be the new backoff change from last week.

olivia: linking to the incident run: https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-4321 and the postmortem draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/987 :link:

maya: action proposal: (1) owner for remediation (2) short-term hotfix to prevent span loss (3) longer-term retry/backpressure revamp.

ana: @sam can you take ownership of the hotfix and coord with eng-infra to apply to dedicated ETL? We need ETA < 24h.

sam: I can own the hotfix. Will write a small guard to force a non-silent fail if ingestion commit fails and add an alert. Targeting deploy within 6 hours.

liam: allocating time to audit the backoff change. I suspect the exponential cap interacts poorly with our sqs batching. I'll validate and submit a revert PR if needed.

olivia: I'll own follow-up on postmortem action items and update the remediation tracker sheet with owners/timelines. I'll also add a recurring checklist so this pattern (missing spans + aggregation drift) is easier to catch.

maya: short checklist for hotfix deploy (sam):
```
- enable fail-open -> false for ingestion-client
- add span emit on commit failure
- add alarm: ETL.span_loss_rate > 0.1% over 5m
- deploy to canary shard then rollout
```

sam: noted. I'll open a PR and post the link here before merging.

incident-bot: deploy started by sam on canary-shard-7 at 2024-07-03T08:10Z :rocket:

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/etl/compare/fix/span-guard (GH #1002). Canary looks good after 30m, no more missing spans on shard-7.

maya: great. olivia, can you add timeline rows: hotfix done (sam) 6h, audit (liam) 48h, long-term backlog item (product+eng) 2w planning.

olivia: done. I added owners and set reminders: 2024-07-05 check-in, 2024-07-10 design review.

liam: quick note — recurring pattern: every 2–3 weeks we see a spike in retries after infra autoscaler changes. I'll add to the recurring incident tracker and propose an instrumentation metric to catch early.

maya: agree. Also filing follow-ups: create a dashboard tile for 'rollup vs raw delta' and add a playbook step to force backfill when delta > 5% for 2 hours. Ticket: OBS-2115.

ana: linking the backfill runbook snippet for quick copy:
```
1) pause rollup job
2) run backfill: scripts/backfill_rollups --start=2024-07-03T02:00 --end=2024-07-03T04:00 --shards=7
3) verify counts vs raw events
4) resume rollup
```

olivia: scheduling owner rotation so action items don't stall — I'll ping owners weekly until OBS-2115 and PR #1002 are closed.

sam: PR merged and hotfix fully rolled out at 2024-07-03T13:40Z. Monitoring for 6h window.

maya: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: olivia to track, liam for audit, sam for final runbook entry, ana to coordinate with Dedicated ops if shards change. Next check-in: 2024-07-05 15:00 UTC. :calendar:

ana: noted and added to calendar.

maya: closing thread for now, will reopen if delta resurfaces. :white_check_mark:
